whenToUse: Building a new website section that must render on the server and be editable in the CMS.
Defining block fields with the schema layer (f.*) and rendering stored pages.
avoidWhen: Ordinary app screens — compose kit components inside a block folder instead.
One-off markup that never goes through the CMS.
a11y: SectionHeader and BlockHeading keep one h1 per page and a correct heading order.
BlockImage requires alt text unless explicitly decorative.
